why: Issue #1014. Opening Developer Tools stops starting the load of `dev-actions`, `dev-diagnostics` and `dev-exports`, so nothing is loaded until a control is pressed and the first press of every control waits on a load it started itself. This is the negative control for THE CONTROL case and for every case that loads the modules the way the page does, by opening the pane (`mountDevLoaded`): without it they could pass with nothing loaded on the open.
